name: Social Music Lounge - Voice Chat
summary:
Welcome to Social Music Lounge, a cozy VR social space where people can relax, talk, and listen together. Join other players in a calm lounge designed for real conversation, shared music, and stress-free evenings.

Meet new people or spend time with friends in a warm social environment with live voice chat. Everyone in the room hears the same music at the same time, making it easy to hang out, talk, and enjoy the atmosphere together.
